purpose: Prospectively test whether one effective breach area identified on the first repeated 50 L, 200 bar cylinder penetration transfers to the second nominally identical pressure-decay experiment without refitting.

source.article_title: Accidental self-ignition of hydrogen released from pressurized cylinder
source.dataset_title: Dataset for: Accidental self-ignition of hydrogen released from pressurized cylinder (Figures 7-9)

known_before_freeze: two repeated nominally identical penetration tests
semi-enclosed repeat-test ambient temperature 3.1 degC and ambient pressure 970 hPa
the archive contains Figure 7 pressure decay plus Figure 8 and Figure 9 temperature data
pre_access_statement.required_action: Commit this protocol before downloading or opening the raw archive.

exclusion_rules: exclude only a curve with fewer than 20 finite samples, non-monotonic time, an initial pressure outside the declared range, or less than 50 percent pressure loss
do not exclude or trim a curve because the model performs poorly
do not use Figure 8 or Figure 9 temperature outcomes to tune the source-pressure model

fixed_split.selection_basis: column order declared in the public Zenodo description before numeric archive access

fixed_preprocessing.pressure_interpretation: reported bar is gauge pressure; convert to absolute pressure by adding 0.970 bar
fixed_preprocessing.initial_pressure: median of the first three finite samples before the detected release onset
fixed_preprocessing.release_onset: first sample at least 1 percent below the initial pressure estimate followed by two further non-increasing samples; shift this sample to t=0
fixed_preprocessing.evaluation_window: from release onset through the last available sample; retain all finite points and do not smooth
fixed_preprocessing.half_pressure_target: ambient absolute pressure plus one half of the initial excess pressure

fixed_model.name: well_mixed_adiabatic_real_gas_blowdown_v1
fixed_model.mass_flux: maximum isentropic flux from vessel stagnation state to ambient pressure
fixed_model.development_parameter: one effective circular breach diameter shared by both repeats
fixed_model.development_objective: minimize pressure RMSE on Pressure n.1 after the frozen onset rule

secondary_outputs: fitted effective breach diameter and development-curve metrics
holdout onset time and sample count
holdout measured and predicted half-pressure times
sensitivity to treating reported bar as absolute rather than gauge, reported separately without changing the primary decision
prohibited_after_outcome_access: changing onset, pressure-unit or evaluation-window rules
changing diameter bounds or primary thresholds
fitting any parameter to Pressure n.2
using ignition occurrence to alter source-depletion parameters
dropping failed points or the failed holdout
claim_boundary: A pass would support transfer of the source-cylinder pressure-depletion submodel between two nominally repeated 20 MPa penetration releases with one development-fitted effective breach area. It would not validate breach geometry, ignition probability or mechanism, flame length, consequence distance, an H70 vessel, the station-to-vehicle fueling loop, emergency response or SAGA effectiveness. A single holdout replicate cannot establish universal release accuracy.
